const int MAXE = 400005;
const int INF = 1000000007;
const int SOURCE = 501;
const int SINK = 502;

int distSafe[MAXN][MAXN];
int distBetween[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

int dirY[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    edges[++edgeCnt] = {u, v, 0, cap, head[u]};
    head[u] = edgeCnt;
    edges[++edgeCnt] = {v, u, 0, 0, head[v]};
    head[v] = edgeCnt;
}

inline bool findPath() {
    queue<int> qu;
    for (int i = 0; i <= SINK; i++) used[i] = depth[i] = 0;
    qu.push(SOURCE);
    used[SOURCE] = 1;
    depth[SOURCE] = 1;
    while (!qu.empty()) {
        int x = qu.front(); qu.pop();
        for (int i = head[x]; i; i = edges[i].nxt) {
            int y = edges[i].v;
            if (!used[y] && edges[i].fl < edges[i].c) {
                parentEdge[y] = i;
                used[y] = 1;
                depth[y] = depth[x] + 1;

            }
        }

            edges[((i - 1) ^ 1) + 1].fl -= pushed;
            remain -= pushed;
            if (remain == 0) break;

}
